[RTCT.11.2] A seed is a **cap-counted** write: it is charged against `cache_cap`
/ `cache_bytes_cap` exactly as a rule `cache` write is, enforced at the store
before any mutation ([RTCT.7.1]). A breach returns `DS_ERR_CONTRACT_BREACH` and
leaves the cache unchanged — restoring a snapshot larger than the configured
caps fails loudly at setup rather than silently truncating.
